english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for explaining what someone means clearly.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for putting an idea into a clear statement or expression.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for making something clear and understandable.
Use this when stressing that the matter is made fully clear or understandable.
Use this when explaining a point or making its meaning clear.
Use this when the emphasis is on making a message or explanation clear, including speaking clearly in general rather than precise enunciation.
